title: Navigation links load correct routes
description: Verify each main navigation link in the application shell routes to the correct page and displays the correct active state.

steps.description: Open the application shell.
Click on the Today link in the sidebar.
Confirm the Today page loads with its respective content.
Click on the Leads link in the sidebar.
Confirm the Leads page loads with the leads data table and filter UI.
Click on the Dashboard link in the sidebar.
Confirm the Dashboard page displays funnel metrics and charts.
Click on the Settings link in the sidebar.
Confirm the Settings page loads with pipeline and team management UI.
Verify that the user menu shows the correct user info.
Select logout from the user menu.
Confirm the user is logged out and redirected appropriately.

title: Today page displays prioritized follow-ups and new leads
description: Verify the Today page loads with daily stats, two tabs showing follow-ups due and new leads, and that leads are prioritized correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the Today page.
Check that daily progress statistics (calls made, connects, etc.) are visible.
Check that the two tab sections 'Follow-ups Due' and 'New Leads' are visible.
Verify that leads in each tab are ordered according to lead scoring priority.
Select a lead from the 'Follow-ups Due' tab.
Verify that the lead detail side panel opens with accurate lead information and timeline.
Switch to the 'New Leads' tab and select a different lead.
Verify that the correct lead detail panel loads for the selected lead.

title: Outcome logging form on Today page enforces conditional validation
description: Ensure that the call outcome form enforces required fields and conditional logic validations based on selected outcomes.

steps.description: Open the Today page and select a lead.
Open the outcome logging form for this lead.
Select an outcome type that requires additional input fields.
Attempt to submit the form without filling required conditional fields.
Verify that form validation prevents submission and displays appropriate error messages.
Fill all required conditional fields and submit the form.
Confirm the form submits successfully and updates the daily stats and follow-up queue.

title: Leads page search and filter functionality
description: Verify that searching and filtering leads on the Leads page updates the data table correctly and handles no-results cases gracefully.

steps.description: Navigate to the Leads page.
Enter a known lead name or identifier in the search bar.
Confirm that the leads table shows only matching leads.
Apply filters such as lead status, stage, or score.
Verify the table updates to show filtered results.
Enter a search term or filter that yields no results.
Confirm that a user-friendly 'no leads found' message is displayed.

title: Leads multi-select bulk actions functionality
description: Verify that multiple leads can be selected and bulk actions (assignment, qualification, export) perform correctly.

steps.description: Go to the Leads page and select multiple leads using checkboxes.
Check that the bulk action toolbar becomes enabled.
Perform a bulk assignment action and assign leads to a BD user.
Confirm all selected leads show the new assigned user.
Perform a bulk qualification action marking leads as qualified or disqualified.
Verify the qualification status updates appropriately in the table.
Use the bulk export action.
Confirm an export file is generated with the selected leads data.

title: Leads detail side panel displays complete and accurate information
description: Confirm the selected lead’s detail side panel or bottom sheet (mobile) shows all relevant information, timeline, and correct interaction history.

steps.description: On the Leads page, select a lead.
Verify detailed lead data fields are populated correctly.
Check that the timeline shows all previous interactions in chronological order.
Ensure the outcome form pre-fills data where applicable and is usable.
On mobile, open the lead details and confirm bottom sheet behaves correctly.

title: Dashboard metrics rendering and drilldown
description: Validate that funnel metrics and charts on the Dashboard load correctly with date and filter controls and that clicking on metrics drills down to filtered lead lists.

steps.description: Navigate to the Dashboard page.
Verify funnel metric cards (calls made, connects, hot leads, conversions, lost leads) are displayed with correct values.
Adjust the date range filters.
Confirm the funnel metrics update accordingly.
Use role-based filters if logged in as a founder or admin.
Verify the filter options are visible or hidden appropriately.
Click on the 'hot leads' metric card.
Confirm it drills down to a filtered leads list matching the metric.
Interact with drop reason analytic chart segments.
Verify the chart drills down to leads filtered by selected drop reason.
Apply filters that result in empty data sets.
Verify empty states are displayed with appropriate messaging.

title: Settings area access control and CRUD operations
description: Ensure only admin users can access full Settings features and that pipelines, stages, drop reasons, and teams can be managed with proper validations.

steps.description: Login as BD user and navigate to Settings.
Verify access restrictions prevent editing and some sections are hidden.
Login as admin user and open the Settings page.
Confirm full access to pipeline, stage, drop reason, and team management tabs.
Create a new sales pipeline with valid data.
Confirm the new pipeline appears correctly in the list.
Attempt to create a pipeline with missing or invalid data.
Verify validation errors prevent creation.
Edit existing stages and update details.
Confirm changes persist and UI updates.
Toggle drop reasons on and off.
Verify toggling is reflected in drop reasons used elsewhere.
Add and remove team members with role assignments.
Check team list updates accordingly and validation blocks invalid input.

title: Responsive design across device layouts
description: Verify that UI components adapt appropriately across desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes including sidebar navigation and modal overlays.

steps.description: Open the application on a desktop screen resolution.
Check the sidebar is visible and navigation links display with appropriate styling.
Resize the viewport to tablet size.
Verify the sidebar collapses or adapts for tablet layout and content remains accessible.
Resize the viewport to mobile size.
Confirm navigation changes to bottom sheet or alternative mobile UI and no content is clipped or inaccessible.
Open modals and overlays such as outcome forms on all screen sizes.
Verify modal responsiveness and dismissal using keyboard and touch controls.

title: Error handling and loading states for data interactions
description: Ensure all data fetching and saving actions on Today, Leads, Dashboard, and Settings pages show appropriate loading indicators, handle API errors gracefully, and display user friendly error messages.

steps.description: Trigger data fetch on Today page.
Verify a loading spinner or skeleton UI is shown.
Simulate a network failure for leads fetch.
Confirm an error message is displayed with retry option.
Attempt to save an outcome with server returning error.
Check error notification is shown and form state remains for retry.
Simulate empty datasets for funnel metrics on Dashboard.
Ensure empty states with helpful messaging are visible.
